parts:
Hi everybody,

I try to build an app with a variable number of similar widgets, I reached to do it but I did not manage to get the inputs of each widget :

my code :

max_plots <- 5
vect = c(1,2,3,4,5)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
  # Insert the right number of plot output objects into the web page
  output$plots <- renderUI({
    plot_output_list <- lapply(1:input$n, function(i) {
      plotname <- paste("plot", i, sep="")
      #plotOutput(plotname, height = 280, width = 250)
      sliderInput(paste("idee",i),"essai",value = vect[i], min = 0,max = 10)
    })
   
    # Convert the list to a tagList - this is necessary for the list of items
    # to display properly.
    do.call(tagList, plot_output_list)
  })
  # Call renderPlot for each one. Plots are only actually generated when they
  # are visible on the web page.
  for (i in 1:max_plots) {
    # Need local so that each item gets its own number. Without it, the value
    # of i in the renderPlot() will be the same across all instances, because
    # of when the expression is evaluated.
    local({
      my_i <- i
      plotname <- paste("plot", my_i, sep="")
     
      output[[plotname]] <- renderUI({
        sliderInput(paste("idee",i),"essai",value = vect[i], min = 0,max = 10)
      })
    })
  }
})


shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
 
  headerPanel("Dynamic number of plots"),
 
  sidebarPanel(
    sliderInput("n", "Number of plots", value=1, min=1, max=5),
    uiOutput("plots")
  ),
 
  mainPanel(
    # This is the dynamic UI for the plots
  )
))
